title: Portable paths
hints: Cutting at the last "/" assumes a slash separator, which Windows doesn't use, and it panics when there is no slash at all.
filepath.Dir(p) and filepath.Base(p) split a path using the right separator for the OS. Dir of a bare file name is ".".
return filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(p), "backup", filepath.Base(p)+".bak"). Join also cleans away a leading "./".
